voice.provider.description: Who synthesizes the voice: fish-audio (Fish Audio's API, drama-3 and the S2 models), openrouter (OpenRouter's speech API), kokoro (local Kokoros server, free), self-hosted (your own OpenAI-shaped speech server, such as vLLM serving drama-3), or say (macOS built-in)

narration.model.description: The Claude model that rewrites a reply as talk before it is read

usage.log.description: Where each paid API request is logged, one JSON line per request (time, provider, model, characters, cost in USD where the provider states it)

narration.style.description: How replies are retold: full keeps everything, said as talk; compact keeps only what matters (decisions, results, numbers, risks, what you must do) and skips the rest

playback.autoStart.description: Start reading as soon as /ml-voice:read runs or a reply is picked; off, the pane prepares the reply and waits for play

cache.dir.description: Where generated audio and narrations are kept, so a reply read again costs nothing. Shared by every session

cache.maxAgeDays.description: Delete cached audio and narrations not played for this many days, checked once a session; 0 keeps them however old

cache.maxSizeMB.description: Cap on the cache's size in megabytes: past it, the least recently played files go first; 0 sets no cap

credentials.fishAudioKey.description: Where your Fish Audio API key lives (fish.audio → Developers). API credit is billed apart from platform credit. A reference, never the key

fishAudio.model.description: Fish Audio model, sent as the model header: drama-3 (most expressive), s2.1-pro, s2-pro, or s2.1-pro-free (no API credit needed)

fishAudio.voice.description: Fish Audio voice model id (reference_id) from fish.audio's library; pick one by name from the list, or leave empty for the default voice

credentials.openrouterKey.description: Where your OpenRouter API key lives (openrouter.ai → Keys). A reference, never the key

openrouter.model.description: OpenRouter speech model id; the list shows each one's price and how many voices it has

openrouter.voice.description: The model's provider-specific voice id: the list holds the voices the chosen model names (Fish Audio's library for a fish-audio model); empty uses its default

kokoro.voice.description: Kokoro voice name, picked from what the server lists, or a mix such as af_sky.4+af_nicole.6

selfHosted.url.description: Your server's OpenAI-shaped speech endpoint, such as http://gpu-box:8091/v1/audio/speech

selfHosted.model.description: The model name your server serves

selfHosted.voice.description: Voice id your server takes, listed from its /v1/audio/voices where it has one; empty uses its default

say.voice.description: macOS voice name, as `say -v '?'` lists them; empty uses the system voice
